verbatim_text: information required under Article 7(2), point (b), and Article 7(5) or by other Union law applicable to the relevant product group
notes: Point (a) refers out. Expanded through Art 7(5)(a)-(e) (all eight substance attributes) and those Art 5(1) aspects judged relevant to apparel; see reference_attribute_set.csv. v1.0 transcription left cdm_field_name blank.

verbatim_text: the unique product identifier at the level indicated in the applicable delegated act adopted pursuant to Article 4

the Global Trade Identification Number as provided for in International Organization for Standardisation/International Electrotechnical Commission standard ISO/IEC 15459-6 or equivalent of products or their parts
notes: CORRECTION: v1.0 transcription named 'dataCarrierStandard', which is not a CDM field. The CDM field is gtin (provenance.csv: Annex III 1(c)).

verbatim_text: relevant commodity codes, such as a TARIC code as defined in Regulation (EEC) No 2658/87

compliance documentation and information required under this Regulation or other Union law applicable to the product, such as the declaration of conformity, technical documentation or conformity certificates
user manuals, instructions, warnings or safety information, as required by other Union law applicable to the product
information related to the manufacturer, such as its unique operator identifier and the information referred to in Article 27(7)
notes: CORRECTION: v1.0 named 'operatorIdentifier'; the CDM field is manufacturerOperatorId. Art 27(7) contact details (postal/electronic address) have no dedicated field: partial at attribute level.

verbatim_text: unique operator identifiers other than that of the manufacturer
information related to the importer, including the information referred to in Article 29(3) and its Economic Operators Registration and Identification (EORI) number
notes: Importer contact details (Art 29(3)) have no dedicated field: partial at attribute level.

verbatim_text: the name, contact details and unique operator identifier of the economic operator established in the Union responsible for carrying out the tasks set out in Article 4 of Regulation (EU) 2019/1020 or Article 15 of Regulation (EU) 2023/988, or similar tasks pursuant to other Union law applicable to the product

notes: OMITTED from the v1.0 transcription and CDM. Identified in the 2026-10-12 review. Consistent with the back-up copy obligation (ESPR Art 10, recital 38) and with Implementing Regulation (EU) 2026/1778, under which the registry stores a reference to the DPP service provider.
